Lina - Partnerships: Heads-up: CatalystLabs reached out asking for marketplace + SI bundling. Need a LangChain connector check, gateway adapter parity, and an announcement calendar. Quick sync 10am PT tomorrow.

Arjun - Eng: Found mismatch when running their sample repo against gateway 2.0; tokenization header mismatch in adapter. Short log: 'AdapterError: header v3 vs v2' — guessing protocol drift.

Pia - DevRel: Can someone paste the exact request payload? I'll update the LangChain demo (`examples/catalyst_demo.ipynb`) and add compatibility table.

Arjun - Eng: minimal repro attached in repo under tests/integration/catalyst. Also raising PR to add negotiation fallback.

Omar - Product: We should pick two shipping SKUs (fast/cheap + high-accuracy) and outline expected latency on A100 vs MLX. Also confirm SI (BlueBridge) supports on-prem installs for regulated clients.

Hannah - Solutions: BlueBridge confirmed EU pilot with a 3-week validation; they need helm values and a quick smoke-test script. I'll draft the deployment checklist.

Marta - Marketing: Proposed timeline: announcement blog + marketplace feature 4/21, joint webinar 4/28. Need assets (screenshots, one-pager, partner quote) by Friday.

Lina - Partnerships: Action list: 1) Eng: fix or document adapter negotiation by Thu. 2) DevRel: update LangChain notebook + publish PR. 3) Solutions: draft BlueBridge pilot runbook by Wed. 4) Marketing: draft comms + assets by Fri. 5) Product: finalize SKUs and pricing guidance.

ci-bot: Reminder: pre-launch sync scheduled 2026-04-02 10:00 PT (link: https://meet.redwood.ai/catalyst-preflight).

Arjun - Eng: I'll add /healthz?model=smoke endpoint for the gateway and aim for <2s on A100. Will also add a small smoke script that returns JSON {status: "ok", model: "sku-default"}.

Pia - DevRel: I'll add compatibility badge generator script for Marketplace README once smoke test is green.

Hannah - Solutions: Sharing draft runbook here later today (will post link).

Lina - Partnerships: Cool. Ping me here if blockers show up before tomorrow. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
